name: IREE: Intermediate Representation Execution Environment
publisher: IREE Project / LF AI & Data Foundation
notes: IREE is an MLIR-based end-to-end compiler and runtime. Lowers ML models to unified IR. Supports JAX, ONNX, PyTorch, TensorFlow/TFLite import. Targets Linux, Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, bare metal, WebAssembly. Architectures: ARM, x86, RISC-V. APIs: Vulkan, ROCm/HIP, CUDA, Metal, AMD AIE (experimental), WebGPU (experimental). Joined LF AI & Data Foundation 2024-05-23. Binary size as low as 30KB on embedded.
